name: Tavi Moss
seed: Repair apprentice; Gorilla mentors workmanship, Iona teaches checks. Hides small mistakes. Home: West Deep.
design: River otter, dark wet-brown fur, teal rolled sleeves, orange repair sash, short tool roll.
history: Born in Millmere and moved with family to West Deep two years ago. Apprenticed after repairing a toy wheel, then discovered real machinery was less forgiving.
desire: To earn a traveling Commonworks placement without being seen as someone’s child.
contradiction: Hides small errors to protect the appearance of competence.
relationships: Gorilla mentors craft; Iona teaches checks; Lume offers a future exchange.
arc: Admits a misfit part before it fails, accepts the lost time, then becomes the person another apprentice can tell the truth to.
story_engine: A repaired chair becomes a running comic prop; a contest tempts him to copy an elegant but unsuitable design.
writer_truth: He has kept the first rejected part as a reminder; it is not evidence of sabotage.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
